I couldn't find Driftmoor's night-dispatch contact in anything you can see. The Coastal channels and the public notes mention the manifest CSV patch for Driftmoor, but none names the night-dispatch contact. Kwame is the one to ask.

Be careful with "Hector": the notes name a night dispatcher called Hector, but he works for Pellucid Harbor Logistics at the Beaumont barge slip, not Driftmoor, so don't send him the Driftmoor note.
